description.narrative: The main objective with the contribution was to: - “increase the levels of participation in higher education; - to grant scholarships to individuals who were committed to the development of their provinces; to reduce disparities in participation between males and females, and geographical regions and rural and urban communities; and - to provide effective, equitable and well-targeted financial assistance for needy students, by financial hardship, from participating in higher education”.

The provincial scholarship programme covers scholarships on grant basis to higher education in Mozambique including master programs and secondary education level 2. The programme covers 7 provinces -N3 financed by Sida (Niassa, Zambezia and Sofala). The objective is to assists students from families with lower income.The World Bank and NL are also a partner to the programme.
